results.name: The bundled renderer rejects script loading and script elements without network requests
Read expands in place; scrolling stays inside the document and the board source is unchanged
Double-click edits inside the card; Save preserves properties and changes only the linked note
Unsaved note edits survive view changes and plugin reload
A conflicting note update cannot be overwritten; the draft can be saved separately
Cards of the same note share edits, and an active draft follows a file rename
Document cards render live Markdown safely while reading on the canvas
Reader refreshes external note edits and resolves explicit Markdown links relative to the document
Document rename, deletion and restoration update the card without altering note bodies
Read on canvas from a planner opens the linked card in place; there is no separate reader view
Day view capture also places the task on the canvas, tracks progress, and keeps overdue work separate
Unscheduled planning and accessible rescheduling change only the due date and undo cleanly
Day tasks move by drag and drop between Unscheduled, the day list and the week strip
Routines repeat on chosen weekdays, tick per day, keep a streak, and stay out of tasks and the canvas
Assignments are editable, searchable and filter the calendar and daily view
Calendar navigation and drag rescheduling preserve canvas positions and persist on disk
Blocked completion still requires the existing confirmation
Source editing makes planner controls read-only; they resume after the editor closes
Document and planning shortcuts never edit hidden selected canvas cards
Narrow desktop viewport keeps Day, Calendar and List usable without horizontal overflow
New in a planner uses the selected day and adds one card without moving others
Compact header and tool palette stay within desktop and narrow panes
Reopening preserves assignments and dates, and creates no copied document body
